note: Synthetic, lexical, deterministic. A drop below these values is a regression on this corpus; it is not evidence about real documents or about answer quality. Re-measured when exact ties were moved from chunk-id order (a hash that includes the tenant: AP then varied with the tenant name, 0.7346-0.7623) to document position (tenant-invariant). The previous value 0.7546 was an artifact of the id order. Average precision is sensitive to how ties are broken, so differences below ~0.03 on this corpus are not signal.
